channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Updated Regional Airfare Zone Cap bookings now available for flights after July 1
item.description: Reduced airfares for remote residents under the updated Regional Airfare Zone Cap scheme are now open for the second half of 2026.

item.title: Durack MP Melissa Price backs new Liberal leader Angus Taylor
item.description: Durack MP Melissa Price has thrown her support behind new Liberal leader Angus Taylor after losing her bid to become the party’s deputy leader on February 13.

item.title: King Leopold Ranges officially renamed after Landgate endorsement
item.description: The brutal legacy of a Belgian monarch has been officially erased from the Kimberley, with the State Government finalising the renaming of the King Leopold Ranges locality to Bularl di Wunami.

item.title: Halls Creek takes Sydney
item.description: Students from Halls Creek District High School trade the red dirt for city lights during an unforgettable cultural trip with Girls from Oz

item.title: Mardi Gras one week to go!
item.description: Broome’s biggest rainbow tropical celebration is gearing up a chock-a-block entertainment program for Broome Mardi Gras 2026, including major UK dance artists set to light up the Kimberley.

item.title: Cracking Comedy in the Park line up announced
item.description: The Boab Metals Ord Valley Muster is bringing back its much-loved Comedy in the Park on May 19, as part of its milestone 25th anniversary celebrations

item.title: RSL Australia president Peter Tinley appointed non-executive director to Mungalalu North Kimberley Airport
item.description: RSL Australia president Peter Tinley has taken up the roll of non-executive director at the remote Mungalalu North Kimberley Airport 40km north of the remote community of Kalumburu.

item.title: Seven Kimberley health professionals selected as finalists in WA Rural Health Awards
item.description: Seven health professionals who have worked across the Kimberley have been selected as finalists in the WA Rural Health Awards this year.

item.title: Horizon Power offers $1.1m for community groups
item.description: Community organisations across the Kimberley are being encouraged to apply for a share of $1.1 million in funding through Horizon Power’s Community Partnerships program, with the latest round now open

item.title: $780,000 received for Kimberley regional arts
item.description: Kimberley artists groups, projects and collectives are among the major recipients of a $780,000 State Government funding boost
